name: Animated Treasure Swarm AP
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun

defensiveAbilities.name: Construct Armor
defensiveAbilities.description: Like normal objects, an animated treasure swarm has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage the swarm takes by an amount equal to its Hardness. Once an animated treasure swarm is reduced to fewer than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon becoming damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks, removing the Hardness and reducing its AC to 21.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blade Storm
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the animated treasure swarm's space takes 6d6 Piercing Damage or 6d6 Slashing Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: One with the Hoard
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The animated treasure swarm is adjacent to Viseldron's hoard

Effect The animated treasure swarm enters Viseldron's hoard, then emerges from the hoard at any other point in, or adjacent to, the hoard's area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Trash the Place
offensiveAbilities.description: The animated treasure swarm hurls its most fragile components in a destructive barrage, dealing 4d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage to all creatures in a 20ft Type:burst within 100 feet (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw save).
